# Momentarise Markdown Editor

Markdown-native framework for portable, preservation-first document editors.

## Public Docs

- [Momentarise Markdown Editor](https://momentarise.dev/docs): Build portable Markdown editors with rich UX, AI assistance, truthful saves, and host-independent contracts.
- [Vanilla Quickstart](https://momentarise.dev/docs/quickstart/vanilla): Mount Momentarise Markdown Editor without a framework.
- [React Quickstart](https://momentarise.dev/docs/quickstart/react): Mount the thin React binding for Momentarise Markdown Editor.
- [Next.js Quickstart](https://momentarise.dev/docs/quickstart/next): Use the React binding from a client-only Next.js boundary.
- [Headless Quickstart](https://momentarise.dev/docs/quickstart/headless): Use the headless editor session without rendering UI.
- [Document Model](https://momentarise.dev/docs/concepts/document-model): Markdown is the durable source; views and artifacts are derived.
- [Preservation](https://momentarise.dev/docs/concepts/preservation): How MME protects Markdown bytes and unknown syntax.
- [Save Truthfulness](https://momentarise.dev/docs/concepts/save-truthfulness): Save state must describe the real persistence target.
- [Document Access Policy](https://momentarise.dev/docs/concepts/policy): Policy decisions gate read, write, share, export, and AI access.
- [Editor UI](https://momentarise.dev/docs/concepts/editor-ui): Source mode, rich view, toolbar, slash menu, outline, and status surfaces.
- [AI And Privacy](https://momentarise.dev/docs/concepts/ai-privacy): AI writing is assistive, staged, and policy-gated.
- [Import, Export, And Rendering](https://momentarise.dev/docs/concepts/import-export): Markdown stays source; HTML and external formats are explicit artifacts or adapters.
- [Preferences And Locks](https://momentarise.dev/docs/concepts/preferences): Hosts resolve user, workspace, document, and locked editor preferences.
- [Extensions](https://momentarise.dev/docs/concepts/extensions): Register commands, toolbar items, slash items, AI actions, and custom blocks.
- [Surface Components](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-surface): Framework-free toolbar, slash menu, command, status, and AI controls.
- [HTML Renderer](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-render-html): Sanitized Markdown-to-HTML rendering for read-only surfaces.
- [HTML Artifact Preview](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-preview-html): Sandboxed preview descriptors for standalone HTML files.
- [Agentic Experience](https://momentarise.dev/docs/concepts/agentic-experience): How MME docs expose Markdown context to coding agents without hiding the source.
- [Performance Budgets](https://momentarise.dev/docs/concepts/performance): CI-runnable performance guardrails for large Markdown documents.
- [Theming](https://momentarise.dev/docs/concepts/theming): Theme MME through tokens, host theme objects, icons, and class maps.
- [Theme System](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-theme): Tokens, host theme objects, icons, and class maps.
- [Core Contracts](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-core): Stable host-independent primitives shared by every MME package.
- [Markdown Parser And Serializer](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-format): Parse Markdown into MME nodes and serialize edited ranges safely.
- [Save Engine](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-save): Dirty, saved, conflict, and persistence-target contracts.
- [Document Access Policy API](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-policy): Gate read, write, share, export, and AI access before work happens.
- [AI Writing API](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-ai): Provider-neutral, policy-gated writing suggestions.
- [Headless Editor Session](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-editor): Session state, outline, events, modes, and extension registry.
- [React Binding API](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-react): Thin React lifecycle wrapper around MME sessions and DOM surfaces.
- [CodeMirror Source View](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-source-codemirror): Source-mode editor behavior, preferences, and host integration.
- [ProseMirror Rich View](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-rich-prosemirror): Rich-mode bridge that keeps Markdown serialization honest.
- [Web File Access](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-adapter-web): Browser file-open and save-target helpers.
- [Theia Adapter](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-adapter-theia): Alpha IDE-shell adapter proving host capability boundaries.
- [CLI For Agents And Developers](https://momentarise.dev/docs/packages/md-cli): Inspect, validate, format, and scaffold Markdown safely.
- [FAQ](https://momentarise.dev/docs/faq): Answers to common integration and product questions.
- [Roadmap](https://momentarise.dev/docs/roadmap): Public framework direction for MME.
- [AI Provider Adapter](https://momentarise.dev/docs/AI_PROVIDER_ADAPTER)
- [Compatibility Promise](https://momentarise.dev/docs/compatibility-promise)
- [Glossary](https://momentarise.dev/docs/GLOSSARY)
